main_topics.reason: The user opened with scalp thinning and a widening part, and it runs through the whole conversation.
The user asked whether the thinning is from PCOS or something else and explored stress as a contributor over several turns.
The user asked what can be done and whether it is permanent, and the bot described several options over a few turns.
The user asked directly whether spironolactone is safe and said they were nervous about hormone medication.
Blood tests for thyroid, iron and vitamins came up as the way to sort out causes and were repeated in the appointment prep.
The user said the widening part freaks them out and asked whether it will keep getting worse; they also said they were scared to look into it.
The user asked what to bring or say so they are taken seriously, and the bot gave a practical list.
The user asked in one turn whether to see a regular doctor or a dermatologist.
The user asked about foods that help in a single exchange.
The user asked in one turn whether to stop straightening their hair.
The user raised exam stress earlier in the year as a possible contributor and asked about it for one exchange.

output.summary: A user with PCOS asked whether gradual hair thinning is from PCOS or something else. The bot covered possible causes including stress, treatment options, spironolactone safety, diet, who to see and how to prepare for the appointment. The user said it helped a lot, felt less scared and planned to book an appointment that week.
